measurement_rules: report Delta_at_old_P, node_shift (one loop), k_star, Delta_at_k_star and the finite-size multiplet estimate separately; none of them is called 'mirror gap'
Cartan sectors G_+ and G_- of twisted runs are reported separately, never averaged (TW2: G_+(delta) = G_-(-delta))
G(beta/2) ~ 1/2 at k_star is a strong positive test for a gapless node; G < 1/2 is NOT a gap proof (Z < 1, continua): beta doubling and dtau halving required
twist runs only for k_star, Delta_min, topology; spontaneous symmetry breaking only from untwisted runs
Trotter extrapolation O = O_0 + c dtau^2 before any central number enters the graph
spectral energies from M1/M2/M3 model comparison (NODE_SPECTRAL_FIT.02), never from the symmetric pair alone
multi-twist reweighting only with N_amp and the coherent N_coh = N_amp R_theta^2 both above 10-20 % of the independent anchor samples
correlation matrices must be PSD for all 0 <= tau <= beta; negative eigenvalues beyond errors mean wrong operators or insufficient statistics
sector traces only with the active Z4 charge inserted directly and only from the symmetric HS integrator; gap from the slope -d log(Z_s/Z_r)/d beta (beta, 2 beta, 4 beta plateau)
twisted runs carry their own sign problem (32 sites, g = 0.03: R = 0.998 / 0.928 / 0.104 at lambda = 1.9 / 0.3 / 0.9); points with R < 0.5 are excluded, R is reported with every twisted point
independent seeds required at every central point: two chains at the same parameters differed by 5 binned sigma (0.261 vs 0.325) -> binned errors at 40 sweeps underestimated by ~3
multi-twist reweighting accepted for local scans (|delta change| <~ 0.15 on 16 sites: N_coh 25-32 of 32)
twisted production points require R > 0.5 and N_amp, N_coh > 0.2 N_eff
spectral statements need the model-free W_Omega interval in addition to M1/M2/M3 fits
sector traces: exact roots of unity for the symmetry phases, slope estimator over beta, 2 beta, 4 beta at fixed dtau; signal-to-noise falls like e^{-beta Delta}
search and confirmation separated: k* located on one set of chains, confirmed only with new independent chains at the fixed k*
predeclared model-free windows Omega = 0.25, 0.5, 1 (t = 1 units); a gap candidate needs W_max -> 0 in a FIXED positive window with improving data
curves whose lowest level is not identifiable (energy Fisher information ~ Z^2) are reported as ENERGY_UNIDENTIFIABLE, never as gap or gapless
g ~ 0.018 is the onset of the departure from the first-order approximation, not a phase transition (finite V, finite beta: responses are smooth in g)

matrix spin-block bounds W_min^{some spin} and W_max^{any spin} per fixed window are reported alongside the pole fit and ZERO.BRACKET; the elementary-block bounds do not replace the active sector test
a final 'passed' statement needs the bounds certified over the continuous frequency range (exact / rational certificate); the float LP on a frequency grid is exploration-grade

Bewertet ist bisher nur das vollstaendig spezifizierte Modell Theta0 (Dirac-Markenwalk mit beta- und Blattmasse): FAIL an Gate B, weil beide Chiralitaetsbloecke bei k = 0 leicht bleiben (vektorartig). Theta1 hat deshalb noch keinen der drei Statuswerte. Nachtrag 2. Oktober (Runden 34-36): Theta1 praezise festgelegt (Weyl-Block, eingefrorener Filter, Spin(10)-Wechselwirkung, triviale Links fuer Gate B, Zellen mit P). Gate B: lokale Bedingung bestanden, Produktbeweis durch Frustration ausgeschlossen, keine Kramers-Vorzeichenfreiheit fuer den BDT-Hamiltonwalk; thermodynamisch offen. Gate C: erster exakter Pruefpunkt (U(1)-Plakette, Gauss-Gesetz, Gatterinvarianz). Artefaktregel eingefuehrt. Theta1 hat weiterhin kein Urteil. Runde 37: Vorzeichenproblem fuer die ganze Klasse strukturell (kein ortslokales Kramers-Theta), gemessene Phase auf der 16-Platz-Zelle bei beta = 1 mild; naechster Schritt: Reweighting-QMC mit Messung der mittleren Phase gegen beta und Volumen. Nachtrag Runden 38-41: Theta1 eindeutig festgelegt (minimal verdoppelnder C3-Hamiltonoperator auf drei Markenrichtungen, structure_hash 2b23ba1ba94c9058); IR-Schutz des leichten Knotens bewiesen (Annahme: Sigma^ regulaer); sechs Gegenterme, keiner aus H_int; exakte Pfaffian-Gewichte mit sieben Einheitstests; mittlere Phase auf 16/32 Plaetzen mild (64 laeuft); erste Spiegelknotenmessung auf 16 Plaetzen (Luecke ~ g, Endlichkeitseffekt nicht ausgeschlossen). Gate B bleibt ohne Urteil, bis Spiegelluecke, Komposite und Symmetrie auf einer homothetischen Zellreihe entschieden sind. Runde 42: Korrektur -- die gemessene Absenkung bei P ist ueberwiegend Knotenverschiebung (79-89 % erster Ordnung), keine Spiegelluecke. Gate-B-Kriterium verschaerft auf min_{k != Gamma} Delta_odd(k) > 0. Naechster entscheidender Contract: CHIRAL4D.MIRROR.NODE_TRACK.01. g/N-Test: auf 32 Plaetzen 98 % Knotenverschiebung; bei schwacher Kopplung kein Spiegel-Gap.
